contentQtextDocument.legacyJson: {"sections": [{"spans": [{"text": "Charles Bronson walked away because he was moved to tears—growing up dirt poor, he’d never received a birthday gift before, and 10-year-old Kurt Russell’s remote-controlled plane touched him so deeply he needed privacy to collect himself.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "", "modifiers": {"embed": {"url": "https://www.quora.com/Why-did-Charles-Bronson-walk-away-without-a-word-when-young-Kurt-Russell-gave-him-a-birthday-present/answer/Jean-Marie-Valheur", "title": "Why did Charles Bronson walk away without a word when young Kurt Russell gave him a birthday present?", "snippet": "", "image_url": "https://qph.cf2.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-a38c6f63b782bb4d08cde77df0ecfb15", "type": "quora", "quora_content_type": 4, "quora_oid": 1477743922881701}}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "hyperlink_embed", "is_rtl": false}]}

content.content: {"sections": [{"spans": [{"text": "It\u2019s probaby the most wholesome Hollywood story ever.", "modifiers": {"bold": true}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "Charles Bronson worked on a show with a very young Kurt Russell, then a ten-year-old child actor. Russell knew it was his older co-stars birthday, and he admired him so he decided to buy him a birthday gift \u2014 a small remote controlled airplane. Bronson took the gift, opened it, and walked off the set without saying a word.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "", "modifiers": {"image": "https://qph.cf2.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-a38c6f63b782bb4d08cde77df0ecfb15", "height": 707, "width": 687, "master_url": "https://qph.cf2.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-2ed1d8064b7dcec6aa62d5bc2281c36a", "is_deleted": false, "is_sensitive": false, "is_uploaded_by_bot": false, "zoomable": true, "dominant_color": "#9b999c", "has_transparency": false, "desktop_crop": {"x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 687, "height": 549}}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "image", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "Russell was afraid he\u2019d upset a man he idolized by giving him a \u201cchildish\u201d gift \u2014 Bronson came across rather serious, stoic and stern. But a short while later, he was called to Brosnon\u2019s dressing room and found the actor visibly emotional. Bronson explained he had grown up dirt poor with fourteen siblings and had never, ever, received a birthday gift before in his entire life. A little model airplane that could actually fly would have been his dream gift, had he been a child.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "This is why Bronson had to walk out; he needed to get himself together, collect himself. Because he didn\u2019t want everyone on the set to see him break down. Kurt Russell recalls how Bronson later gifted him a skateboard for his own birthday and the two of them would ride skateboards together between sets, as Bronson was unexpectedly good at skateboarding.", "modifiers": {"bold": true}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}]}
